svg.title: BlaBla architecture
svg.desc: project.bla composes behavior and structure contracts. Behavior contracts are parsed and type-checked into one typed contract IR that the behavior verifier runs as a coverage-guided campaign against the application through the trusted runtime, with counterexample shrinking. Structure contracts are parsed into a structure IR that the structure verifier evaluates against facts from a language provider, in v0.5 the Python provider running an embedded AST extractor. The behavior result is recorded with a run-state marker; structure is evaluated live. blabla status, explain and finish render both layers and the OVERALL gate.
